summary: Comprehensive test suite covering unit logic, CLI I/O, and workflow integration. Validates all major requirements: cartesian products, include/exclude rules, maxSize enforcement, GitHub Actions structure, and act-based end-to-end testing with exact output assertions. Strong TDD approach indicated by per-component describe blocks. Well-isolated fixtures and proper cleanup. Main gaps: no direct tests for summarize.ts (only indirect via act), extract() output parsing could be more robust, missing some error scenarios (e.g., exclude removing all combos), and static workflow tests run outside act despite requirements stating all tests should go through pipeline. Would catch most regressions but has minor brittleness in act output parsing and could benefit from stress-testing larger matrices.
